quantity_model.name: per_unit
steps: Use the source spray area, already calculated from width ? length ? spray frequency ? spray days.
Apply the source tanker rate 0.008 hours per 100?.
Keep water supply installation or utility costs outside this rate, as stated by the source.
quantity_model.rounding: 총 투입량은 정확한 유리수로 보존; 단위당 품은 공통 1-2-8·1-2-1 기본 자릿수 적용

not_calculated.item: Water supply facility or utility charges when site water is unavailable
not_calculated.reason: The source directs separate cost accounting and provides no rate in this item.

calc_type_reason: Source explicitly gives 0.008 equipment-hours per 100?; shared per_unit calculator uses the cumulative spray-area input.
